patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.chiefComplaint: Family says he isn't making sense
clinical.quoteLong: I'm not sick, I'm informed. I've been reading about this for eleven years and my daughter has decided that's a symptom. Go on — ask me about the water supply.
clinical.presentationShort: 52yo M — long-standing fixed beliefs, unchanged, brought by family. Oriented, at baseline, no danger to self or others.
clinical.presentationLong: 52-year-old male with long-standing unchanged fixed beliefs brought in by family; fully oriented, functioning at his usual baseline, denies any thoughts of harm.

diagnosis.primary: Chronic delusional disorder, stable — no acute psychiatric emergency
diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: medically stable and low risk with no ED resources expected; Psych is preferred, and Fast Track is acceptable.

diagnosis.why: Long-standing, unchanged, no danger, at baseline. A brief Psych assessment is reasonable; Fast Track is also acceptable for a low-acuity medical screening.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 52-year-old man in a flannel shirt with a thick folder of papers, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting forward, one finger raised mid-point, papers spilling from a folder on his lap
signs: a bulging folder of annotated papers
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 52-year-old man in a flannel shirt with a thick folder of papers, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting forward, one finger raised mid-point, papers spilling from a folder on his lap. Expression: earnest, animated and entirely lucid. Clearly visible: a bulging folder of annotated papers; alert engaged eyes. Overall: physically well and fully alert. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
